div.div:
Logical OO design: each class combines schema attributes and operations allocated by responsibility from existing module behavior.
Operations are design mappings, not literal Prisma instance methods; signatures are condensed. Page 04 preserves selected actual module functions.
Multiplicity follows the current schema. Checkout creation requires 1–20 orders. External user/product/address IDs are scalar references.
Source: backend/services/order-service/prisma/schema.prisma + src/. Operation mapping: operations.json. Notation: OMG UML 2.5.1.
